steps.instruction: Wash and chop the apple, removing the core.
Add oats and the package-directed amount of tap water to a saucepan. Cook according to the oat package.
Stir in the apple and cinnamon; cook until the apple is softened and the oats are ready. Serve warm.
Cook the oats with the package-directed amount of tap water.
Peel and slice the banana.
Stir peanut butter into the cooked oats, top with banana, and serve.
Drain chickpeas. Cook oats with the package-directed amount of tap water.
In a skillet, warm oil and add spinach and chickpeas. Cook spinach according to its package, stirring until the mixture is hot throughout.
Spoon the spinach and chickpeas over the oats and serve.
Drain chickpeas. Peel and chop onion.
Warm oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring, until softened.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and cumin. Simmer, stirring, until hot throughout and the onion is tender; serve.
Drain chickpeas. Wash pepper, remove stem and seeds, and dice.
Warm oil in a skillet. Cook pepper until softened, then add chickpeas and cumin and heat throughout.
Warm tortillas according to their package. Divide filling among them and serve.
Cook quick-cooking brown rice according to its package using tap water.
Drain beans. Combine beans, tomatoes and cumin in a saucepan and simmer, stirring, until hot throughout.
Spoon the bean mixture over the rice and serve.
Cook pasta in tap water according to its package; drain.
Drain beans. Warm oil, tomatoes and beans in a saucepan and simmer until hot throughout.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve.
Prepare couscous with tap water according to its package.
Drain chickpeas. Warm oil in a skillet, add spinach and chickpeas, and cook according to the spinach package until hot throughout.
Stir into the couscous and serve.
Wash and cut sweet potato into small, even cubes. Peel and chop onion; drain beans.
Warm oil in a skillet. Add onion and sweet potato with a splash of tap water, cover and cook, stirring regularly and adding water as needed, until the potato is tender.
Add beans and cumin, stir until hot throughout, and serve.
Cook quick-cooking brown rice with tap water according to its package. Drain chickpeas; peel and dice onion.
Warm oil in a skillet and soften onion. Add tomatoes and chickpeas, stirring until hot throughout.
Serve the tomato chickpeas over the rice.
Cook pasta in tap water according to its package and drain. Drain white beans.
Warm oil in a skillet. Add spinach and beans and cook according to the spinach package until hot throughout.
Stir in cooked pasta, warm through, and serve.
Drain and mash beans. Wash pepper and remove stem and seeds. Dice pepper and peeled onion.
Warm oil in a skillet. Cook pepper and onion until tender; stir in beans and cumin and heat throughout.
Spread filling on tortillas, fold in half and warm each side in the skillet until lightly crisp; serve.
Prepare the fruit or vegetables: wash fresh produce, remove cores or peels, and chop into small pieces. Drain and rinse any canned beans.
Cook the quick-cooking rice flakes in a saucepan with the package-directed amount of tap water. Stir frequently until soft.
Stir in the chopped apple and cinnamon. Simmer until the apple softens; add water as needed and serve warm.
Prepare the fruit or vegetables: wash fresh produce, remove cores or peels, and chop into small pieces. Drain and rinse any canned beans.
Cook the quick-cooking rice flakes in a saucepan with the package-directed amount of tap water. Stir frequently until soft.
Mash the peeled banana into the cooked flakes, stir in cinnamon and warm through.
Prepare the fruit or vegetables: wash fresh produce, remove cores or peels, and chop into small pieces. Drain and rinse any canned beans.
Cook the quick-cooking rice flakes in a saucepan with the package-directed amount of tap water. Stir frequently until soft.
Stir in the chopped apple and simmer until soft. Top with sliced banana and serve warm.
Prepare the fruit or vegetables: wash fresh produce, remove cores or peels, and chop into small pieces. Drain and rinse any canned beans.
Cook the quick-cooking rice flakes in a saucepan with the package-directed amount of tap water. Stir frequently until soft.
Stir in the frozen spinach, drained chickpeas and oil. Simmer, stirring, until the spinach and beans are steaming hot throughout.
Prepare the fruit or vegetables: wash fresh produce, remove cores or peels, and chop into small pieces. Drain and rinse any canned beans.
Cook the quick-cooking rice flakes in a saucepan with the package-directed amount of tap water. Stir frequently until soft.
Stir in the canned tomatoes, drained white beans and cumin. Simmer until steaming hot throughout.
Drain and rinse the beans. Place beans, canned tomatoes and cumin in a saucepan. Simmer for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until steaming hot.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry skillet, turning until soft.
Mash some of the beans to thicken the filling, divide between the tortillas and serve.

recipes.title: Spinach and white bean breakfast skillet

steps.instruction: Drain and rinse the white beans. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add frozen spinach, canned tomatoes and beans. Cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring and adding a splash of water if needed, until steaming hot throughout.
Mash a few beans into the sauce and serve warm.
Drain and rinse the canned beans. Wash and finely dice any fresh vegetables.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the vegetables and seasoning with a splash of water. Cover and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until tender and any frozen vegetables are steaming hot.
Stir in the beans and cook for another 3–4 minutes until steaming hot throughout. Add water if needed and serve.

Mash the chickpeas with a fork, leaving some texture.
Warm tortillas on both sides in a dry skillet. Fill with the chickpea mixture and serve.

Reduce to a steady simmer and cook for 10–12 minutes, stirring, until the lentils are soft. Add more water if needed.
Stir in frozen spinach and simmer until steaming hot throughout. Serve once the lentils are fully tender.

Stir in quick-cooking rice flakes and cook according to the package, adding more water as needed.
Stir in the beans and oil. Heat until steaming hot throughout and serve.
